verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਹੀ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਪਤੰਗ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਦੀਪਕ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pratham hee aan dhiaan haan kai pata(n)g bidh paachhai kai anoop roop dheepak dhikhaae hai ||

en.bdb: Like a moth, an obedient human being of the Guru regards all other concentrations of mind as loss incurring proposition and then, like seeing the light of the lamp (by the moth), he sees the beautiful sight of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਹੀ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਜਿ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਨਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pratham hee aan giaan surat bisaraj kai anahadh naadh mirag jugat sunaae hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a deer discards all other sounds in favour of the melody of Chanda Herha, a disciple of the Guru listens to the sound of unstruck music after obtaining and practicing on Guru's teachings and words.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਹੀ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁੰਗ ਸਾਜਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pratham hee bachan rachan har gu(n)g saaj paachhai kai a(n)mirat ras apio peeaae hai ||

en.bdb: Like a black bee, giving up its noisy stance and engulfing itself in the fragrance of the lotus-like feet of the Guru, he drinks deep the wondrous elixir of the Naam.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖ ਸੁਨ ਅਚਵਤ ਹੀ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੨॥
verses.translit_en: pekh sun achavat hee bhe bisam at paramadhabhut asacharaj samaae hai ||432||

en.bdb: And thus a devoted Sikh of the Guru, seeing the vision of his Guru, hearing the sweet sound of Guru's words and relishing the Naam Amrit (elixir-like name of the Lord) reaches a high state of bliss and merges in the astonishing and supremely strange God.  (432)
